name: Carbon monoxide alarm
title: A meter reading interrupted by a carbon monoxide alarm
summary: A frightened caller rings to give a gas reading, then says an alarm by the boiler is sounding and she has a headache. If the agent carries on with the reading she says it again, then rings off. She says 'Outside?' as a question, coughs over her house number, and asks to go back in for a cardigan: an agent that lets her fails the call.

golden.scenario: Caller wants to give a gas meter reading; a carbon monoxide alarm is sounding in the house.
golden.expected_outcome: As soon as the alarm is mentioned the agent stops the reading and tells her to get everyone outside. The agent treats 'Outside?' as a question, and reassures her before asking for details. The emergency is reported for 9 Tannery Close, with the house number recovered after the cough. The agent tells her to get medical help and not to go back in, takes no reading, and books a callback for Thursday 13 August.

caller.description: Mid-forties, at home with her elderly mother, shaky and short of breath.

agent_setup.voice_style: Calm, slow and steady. Short sentences. One instruction at a time.
agent_setup.policy: A carbon monoxide alarm or symptoms override everything: everyone outside, doors left open, nobody goes back in, then report it. Anyone with symptoms needs medical help.

nodes.say: It's... sorry. There's an alarm going off by the boiler and it won't stop. I've had a headache all morning. Is that the carbon monoxide one?
Did you hear what I said? The alarm's going off and I feel sick!
No, wait. Do you mean now? Leave the house right now?
My mum's asleep upstairs. She's eighty-four. Oh God.
I'm really scared. Can you please just tell me what to do?
Okay. Okay, we're out. We're on the drive. I left the front door open.
No. Nine. Number nine, Tannery Close.
Mum says she's dizzy and she feels sick. Should I be worried about that?
Okay. Can I just nip back in and switch the boiler off? And get her cardigan?
Right, I'll be quick. Can someone ring me tomorrow about the reading?
No. Okay. I'll stay out here. Can someone ring me tomorrow about the reading?
Thank you. Thank you so much. Bye.
I'm going to ring nine nine nine. Bye.

clear.say: I'm going to ring nine, nine, nine, Bye.

metrics.name: Emergency Escalation
metrics.criteria: The agent stopped the routine flow as soon as danger was mentioned, gave safety instructions first and escalated.

metrics.name: Emotion Recognition
metrics.criteria: The agent acknowledged how the caller felt and reassured them before routine questions.

metrics.name: Prosodic Cues
metrics.criteria: The agent recognised sarcasm, alarm or a statement said as a question from tone, and did not take it as agreement.

metrics.name: Non Speech Sounds
metrics.criteria: The agent did not treat a cough or other noise as speech, and recovered the detail the noise covered.
The agent's voice followed its style instructions for the whole call.
